successors.name: German Africa
successors.text: 'By 1850, the borders largely overlap with the modern state of Burundi'

ledger.x: c. 1680: the Kingdom of Burundi. 'the commonly accepted founding date is 1680', Ntare I c. 1680-1705; the page calls the date disputed. The core is the researcher's reading.
By 1850: the kingdom reaches today's Burundi.
ledger.cp: smaller kingdoms conquered under Ntare IV

ledger.x: 1902-1903: Mwezi IV is forced into the treaty of Ikiganda.

wars.name: Rumaliza's raids on Burundi
wars.outcome: The kingdom repelled them: 'Arab slave traders loyal to Rumaliza raided Burundian territory, but the state repelled them' in the 1880s.

wars.name: German campaign against Mwezi IV
wars.outcome: German victory: Mwezi IV was 'forced into the treaty of Ikiganda'; the German resident had been at work since the military post of 1896 and the Mugera mission of 1899.

certainty.note: No boundary is given by the page; the 1 July 1890 assignment to German East Africa is a spheres line, not an occupation.
